title: German RSE Survey Books
text: Each survey year focuses only on respondents working in Germany and is presented independently using the questions and answer options contained in that year’s dataset. No cross-year harmonisation is applied.

2026 curated Nordic analysis

The 2016 export contains only United Kingdom respondents, so it is not included in this Germany-focused publication. All published yearly books are generated dynamically from the corresponding response and question-metadata files. The country is configurable when generating a book, so the same process can produce books for other countries represented in a given year.
The separate 2026 Nordic analysis preserves the curated narrative and question-by-question analysis using its committed frozen results. Generic books include submitted and partial records, and each question reports how many of each provided an answer. The curated analysis remains submitted-only.
